description: This file defines the EndpointOptions class used for configuring silo endpoint settings in Orleans, including IP addresses and ports for silo-to-silo and silo-to-client communication, with methods for binding configuration values.

classes.name: EndpointOptions
classes.description: Class for configuring Orleans silo endpoint options, including IP addresses and ports for silo and gateway communication, with methods for validation and configuration binding.

methods.name: GetPublicSiloEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the public silo endpoint as an IPEndPoint using the advertised IP address and silo port.

methods.name: GetPublicProxyEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the public proxy endpoint, using GatewayPort if set, otherwise null.

methods.name: GetListeningSiloEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the listening silo endpoint, defaulting to the public silo endpoint if not explicitly set.

methods.name: GetListeningProxyEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the listening proxy endpoint, defaulting to the public proxy endpoint if not explicitly set.

methods.name: Bind
methods.description: Binds configuration values from an IConfiguration object to the EndpointOptions properties, parsing IP addresses and endpoints.
